cohort: A single 32-year-old gravida 2 para 0+1 woman managed for uterine fibroids in pregnancy and placenta previa major.
finding: The case highlights the possibility of uterine arteriovenous malformation (AVM) coexisting with uterine fibroids.
mod_finding: An emergency Caesarean section was required due to preterm labour, and intraoperatively a thinned-out bulge was found between intramural uterine fibroids.
